# DestinationReference { #timetoalign.timelines.DestinationReference }

```python
timelines.DestinationReference(
    jump,
    to=None,
    by=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
)
```

One destination of a Jump, named by that Jump and its place.

The value of ``after``. The place keys are left out for the destination
without place, or when the Jump has one destination only.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                      | Description                                         |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| jump   | [str](`str`)                                                                                              | The ID of the Jump.                                 |
| to     | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                      | The ``to`` of the destination meant, if it has one. |
| by     | [Duration](`timetoalign.core.Duration`) \| [_Number](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol._Number`) \| None | The ``by`` of the destination meant, if it has one. |
